title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers' Irelands climate action project in Sierra Leone is implemented in Kerena and Freetown, supports young women and men with disabilities and eye care facilities. It involves mapping climate action stakeholders, organising workshops with organisations of persons with disabilities (OPDs) and youths to understand their needs, and build their engagement in climate action. Advocacy efforts focus on involving OPDs and youth with disabilities in climate decision-making and making climate policies to be disability inclusive. In our eye health programme, a climate adaptation and environmental sustainability toolkit will be developed. Adaptation: - The project will advocate for and support the participation of people with disabilities organisations and youth with disabilities' organisations to engage in policy and decision-making processes on climate change ensuring their voices are heard and included at the national and regional level.
